Rhea (CS): Heads-up — CrossBeam just hit renewal watch after a steady token-cost increase (+21%) and a couple of slow long-doc summaries. AE wants a low-risk mitigation we can show them this week. Proposing a short pilot: compact-int8 for short/mid docs + explicit routing for long tails. Thoughts?
Luca (SE): Can we do language/length-aware split? Their traffic is mostly English, median 640 tokens but ~14% >2200. Recommend routing <=1200 to compact-int8 with prefix_kv, >1200 to standard fp16 on dedicated during peak.
Maya (RE): I can run fidelity checks on their golden 4k prompts. Will measure embedding drift, BLEU, and hallucination heuristics. Also test prefix_kv on/off — prefix caching often helps their repeat-header docs.
Ben (AE): Customer sensitivity: legal/regulatory notes in outputs. They need a 1-pager with risk summary and an on/off toggle they can control. Also request a 48-hour opt-in pilot window.
Rhea (CS): OK plan: 1) staging canary split route for <=1200 seq (80% compact-int8 / 15% standard-fp16 / 5% dedicated fallback). 2) prefix_kv enabled for compact cohort. 3) run fidelity & per-length bucket metrics, surface any "critical-case" regressions. 4) one-pager + pilot opt-in instructions.
Luca (SE): I'll push a staging route and collect p50/p95/p99 + token_cpm delta. Snippet I'll use in staging:```
route {
  match: path: "/v1/summarize"
  condition: "seq_len <= 1200"
  split: "80/15"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-highmem"
}
route {
  match: path: "/v1/summarize"
  condition: "seq_len > 1200"
  models: ["redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_batch_ms: 40 }
```
AlertBot: [monitoring] crossbeam-prod token_cost_change=+21% window=2026-01-07T08:00Z->2026-01-07T14:30Z p95=1.15s p99=2.9s
Maya (RE): Running A/B now. I'll include per-model per-length buckets and flag any prompts with >1% faithfulness drop. If we see citation losses on long contexts, we'll recommend raising cutoff to 1600 or forcing fp16 for those buckets.
Ben (AE): Please include clear rollback triggers in the one-pager: any critical-case regression (customer-provided list) OR >1.5% absolute drop on core metric. Also include how to pause pilot instantly.
Rhea (CS): Timeline: Luca staging perf & dashboard (ETA 3h), Maya fidelity eval + flagged cases (ETA 6h), Ben to schedule a 20-min customer pilot opt-in call (ETA EOD), Rhea to draft one-pager (ETA EOD).
Luca (SE): Deploying staging route now. Will post dashboard link and a CSV of latency & cost deltas when ready.
Maya (RE): Early results (uploaded to /shared/crossbeam-evals): compact-int8 cohort est cost -23% for <=1200 bucket; median latency -13%, p99 -17%. Quality: 93% of prompts show negligible embedding drift; 5 prompts flagged where fp16 preserved specific phrasing for legal citations.
Ben (AE): Good initial numbers. Rhea, include a table in the one-pager: savings by length bucket + flagged examples and recommended cutoff. I'll ask customer to supply 3 critical-case samples before pilot start.
Rhea (CS): Will do. Also adding a note: recommend dedicated small pool during their 9am-6pm local hours to cover p99 spikes. This is optional but lowers risk.
Luca (SE): One technical note — test prefix_kv on vs off in the pilot. In many cases it reduces downstream tokens for repeated headers. I'll include both metrics.
Maya (RE): If the customer agrees, I'll run a quick additional check on their flagged prompts with fp16 fallback forced to quantify the diff per-case.
AlertBot: [deploy] staging-split-route created by luca at 2026-01-07T10:34Z (id: dpl_4987654332)
Rhea (CS): Thanks team — tight pilot with clear rollback and per-length tradeoffs should give the AE something to present. Keep updates short here and put artifacts in /shared/crossbeam-evals. :thumbsup:
